info.title: FutureBank Demo API
info.description: OpenAPI contract for the authenticated read/write FutureBank demonstration API. It covers CRM, Passport and National ID files, accounts, immediate and scheduled payments, payment reversals, direct debits, end-of-day charges and interest, clearing reconciliation, general-ledger projection and manual journals, maker-checker accounting-period close, loan origination, KYC, overdrafts, work queues and audit data. All people, documents, screening results and policies are fictional. Mutations use the same role, maker-checker, KYC, hold, ledger and audit controls as the user interface.

get.description: Lists open, closing and closed periods with versioned close evidence.

200.description: Accounting period and latest close work item.

get.description: Returns period status, request and decision evidence, version and latest maker-checker work item.

post.description: A Supervisor locks the period, proves final end-of-day and later reconciliation evidence, zero open exceptions, full clearing coverage, no running process and a balanced ledger, then creates an Admin approval item and freezes the period while closing.
A distinct Admin rechecks all close gates under locks and either closes the period or returns it to OPEN. CLOSING and CLOSED dates reject every runtime ledger writer.

get.description: Returns the currency-specific settlement, customer-control, income and expense accounts used by automated and manual journals.
Aggregates posted journal lines only, optionally within an inclusive date range and currency, and reports exact debit, credit and natural balances.
Lists automated subledger projections and pending, posted or rejected manual journals with their balanced lines.

post.description: A Supervisor submits one exact two-line, same-currency journal into pending state; no trial-balance movement occurs until a distinct Admin approves it.

200.description: Journal, lines, actor evidence and latest work item.

get.description: Returns a journal's immutable accounting lines, source transaction, submission and decision evidence, version and maker-checker work item.

post.summary: Approve or reject a manual journal
post.description: A distinct Admin locks the work item and journal, rechecks the open accounting period, account availability, currency and exact balance, then posts once or rejects without movement.

get.description: Lists pending, approved or rejected loan proposals with snapshotted terms, affordability ratio and booking references.

post.description: An Operator submits exact fictional affordability data against an active loan product and the customer's own currency-matched deposit account. The proposal is idempotent and creates a Supervisor approval item without ledger movement.

200.description: Loan application, decision evidence, booking references and schedule.

post.summary: Approve or reject a loan application
post.description: A distinct Supervisor or Admin locks and rechecks current KYC, restrictions, affordability, product, destination, posting period and terms. Approval creates one loan account, exact schedule, balanced subledger transaction, general-ledger projection and destination credit atomically; rejection creates no financial movement.

put.summary: Upload or replace a customer document
put.description: Uploads or replaces one private Passport or National ID file. Requires KYC_GATHER; accepts JPEG, PNG or PDF up to exactly 4 MiB after MIME and file-signature validation.

file.description: Non-empty JPEG, PNG or PDF whose declared MIME type matches its file signature; maximum 4,194,304 bytes.

requestBody.description: A single multipart part named file. The route rejects other Content-Types with 415.

delete.description: Idempotently deletes one customer file slot. Requires KYC_GATHER and never changes identity-document metadata.

get.description: Streams authenticated private Passport or National ID bytes. This operation is not JSON-wrapped and is never cacheable.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment disposition containing a sanitized filename.

BearerAuth.description: The FUTUREBANK_API_KEY supplied as an HTTP Bearer token. This is an alternative to X-API-Key, not a staff OAuth token.

StaffActor.name: X-Staff-Username
StaffActor.description: Active staff username used as the audit actor. Required for writes. Permissions and maker-checker separation are evaluated for this user.

Query.name: query
Query.description: Unicode search text. Customer searches accept Arabic-script names as well as Latin transliterations and identifiers.

error.message: A valid API key is required.

shortName.description: Unicode short name. May contain both a Latin transliteration and native Arabic-script name.

kycReviewDate.description: Review date. Defaults to one year after creation when omitted.

addressLine1.description: Unicode address line; Arabic-script text is accepted.

country.description: Address country. Defaults to residenceCountry when omitted.

identityDocumentNumber.description: When provided, identityDocumentType, identityIssuingCountry, identityIssuedAt and identityExpiresAt are also required.

givenName.description: Unicode given name; Arabic script is accepted.

familyName.description: Unicode family name; Arabic script is accepted.

legalName.description: Unicode SME legal name; Arabic script is accepted.

PaymentReversalRequest.description: Full-value reversal request; the idempotency key is supplied as a header.

PaymentInstructionWrite.description: Future-dated or recurring payment intent. Scheduled instructions require ONCE; standing orders require WEEKLY or MONTHLY.

PaymentInstructionRunWrite.description: Business date for a due-instruction run.

DirectDebitMandateWrite.description: Customer authority granted to an owned active beneficiary creditor.

DirectDebitCollectionWrite.description: One immediate collection request; the idempotency key is supplied as a header.

DocumentSlot.description: Fixed customer file slot. Only Passport and National ID are supported.

DocumentMeta.description: Safe document metadata. Private Blob URLs, paths, hashes and file bytes are never returned.

Address.description: A postal address held in CRM.

country.description: ISO-style country code or seeded country value.

type.description: EMAIL, MOBILE or another supported channel.

preferred.description: Whether this is the preferred channel.

IdentityDocument.description: Identity-document metadata; this is distinct from the private uploaded file.

Relationship.description: Relationship to another customer, controller or beneficial owner.

ownershipPercent.description: Ownership percentage as a decimal string.

beneficialOwner.description: Whether the related party is a beneficial owner.

Product.description: A banking product available for account opening.

interestRate.description: Annual percentage rate as a decimal string.

active.description: Whether new accounts may be opened.

displayName.description: Unicode retail full name or SME legal name.

readOnly.description: Whether API/UI debit mutations are disabled.

Transaction.description: A booked or pending account movement.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version required by decisions and assignment changes.

AccountHold.description: Funds reserved for a pending payment without a ledger movement.

Payment.description: Payment detail including approval hold and work item.

destinationReference.description: Destination account number or beneficiary identifier.

PaymentReversal.description: Full-value payment correction request and its independent approval outcome.

PaymentInstructionExecution.description: One scheduled occurrence and its linked payment outcome.

PaymentInstruction.description: Future payment intent, schedule state and occurrence history. It does not represent reserved funds or a ledger booking.

ProcessingRun.description: Outcome counters for one due-instruction processing run.

DirectDebitCollection.description: A creditor collection and its linked payment outcome.

DirectDebitMandate.description: Direct debit authority, limit, lifecycle and collection history.

businessDate.description: Non-future business date claimed at most once.
Non-future settlement date reconciled at most once.

AuditEvent.description: Append-only audit event without private file content or URLs.

deleted.description: True when a document record existed and was deleted; false when the slot was already empty.

Error.description: Structured API error. Authentication failures are 401, actor/permission failures are 403, missing entities are 404, conflicts are 409, unsupported upload media is 415, and unavailable dependencies are 503.
